doc.title: Tom Albert and Milton "Mooney" Martin Interview, 1964-12-21

chapter: Algiers places, ball games and Frankie Duson
title: Buddy and Yank Johnson's family, house and barbershop
summary: Russell asks whether Yank was also a barber and whether the Johnson brothers were Bunk's cousins; Martin says no. He places their house on Nunez Street and says the barbershop stood next to Lopez's pie shop.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: I was gonna ask about, uh, Buddy Johnson, was he a barber too, or just his brother? Yeah, he was a barber. Both of them. No, no. Oh no, I don't mean, I mean Yank is what I mean.
Yank wasn't a barber. Yank wasn't a barber. Uh huh. Did they have anybody else in the family that played music? Well, I just know them two brothers. I just know them two brothers.
I just know them two brothers.
I think Bunk Johnson said they were cousins of his. I just wondered if their father played. Bunk never told me anything about them either. He wasn't no cousin of Bunk.
